title: Excitebike (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

widgets.text: Turbo raises the temperature gauge; at the top the engine overheats and you stop by the track to cool down. Driving over the arrow strips cools the engine.
Land on both wheels, matching the slope (tilt with Left/Right in the air). Hitting another rider's back wheel crashes you; clipping his front wheel crashes him.
Five tracks; Selection A races alone, Selection B adds rival riders. Design mode lets you build tracks.
Qualify under the target time (3rd place or better) to move to the next track.
Clear all five tracks in a selection. Each track shows a qualifying time; a run under it (3rd place or better) moves you on, and the best times are kept for the session.
